title: Corsair reports strong second quarter 2026 profit growth and cash generation
publisher: Corsair Gaming, Inc. via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: Full-year guidance increased to $1.40-$1.47 billion revenue, $121-$131 million adjusted EBITDA, and $0.85-$0.94 non-GAAP EPS after a material one-time Q2 tariff refund.
summary: The SEC-filed release supports Q2 underlying-profit normalization, updated full-year guidance, segment trends, operating catalysts and the distinction between recurring progress and the one-time tariff benefit.
